## 2026-09-28

### Changes

- Network interception events now include a stable request identifier, making it easier to recognize and deduplicate repeated observations of the same request.
- Improved selector handling for browser automation commands.
- Strengthened validation and failure handling for session connectivity and encrypted transport setup.

### Requirements

| Name  | Version |
| ----- | ------- |
| Xcode | >= 26.1 |
| iOS   | >= 15.0 |
